note: Achievements are all educational milestones: no purchase, no loot box, no random reward. Points are knowledge points, spent on nothing — they only measure progress.

achievements.title: First Steps
achievements.description: Enter the central hall of the museum.

achievements.title: Archive Opened
achievements.description: Open the Digital Archive for the first time.

achievements.title: The Student Years
achievements.description: Complete the Early Life & Education gallery.

achievements.title: Standing for Equality
achievements.description: Complete the Social Reform gallery and both mini-games.

achievements.title: We, the People
achievements.description: Complete the Law & Constitution gallery and its quiz.

achievements.title: In the Stacks
achievements.description: Complete the Books, Manuscripts & Scholarship archive.

achievements.title: Places of Memory
achievements.description: Visit the memorial reconstructions and complete the map exercise.

achievements.title: In Conversation
achievements.description: Ask the Archive Guide five questions.

achievements.title: Researcher
achievements.description: Run ten searches across the archive.

achievements.title: Collector — 25 Items
achievements.description: Record 25 archive items in your digital archive.

achievements.title: No Hesitation
achievements.description: Answer every question in a quiz correctly on the first attempt.

achievements.title: Read the Source
achievements.description: Open the source citation of five archive records.

achievements.title: The Final Challenge
achievements.description: Pass all six stages of the final knowledge challenge.

achievements.title: HERITAGE ARCHIVIST
achievements.description: Complete the whole Digital Heritage Journey.

progressDashboard.note: Shown on the achievement wall and on the completion certificate screen.
